explication: claude-red is a curated library of 78 offensive-security SKILL.md documents for Claude. The principal workflow is: an operator sends a security question, Claude matches conversational triggers, the Claude Skills system reads the relevant category documents, and Claude returns domain-specific guidance. The manifest supports machine-readable cataloguing. Category coverage is represented directly from the README; implementation wiring beyond the sampled converter and manifest generator is not inspected, so only documented loading relationships are shown.
